keyFindings.text: **Hook trust is code-enforced, and its cost on a secondary checkout is silent degradation made audible only by a NOTICE.** Both hooks compare the hook script's git common dir with the checkout's; when they differ and `git config --local skilled.trustRepoHooks` is not exactly `true`, `SOURCE_ROOT` becomes `.skilled-untrusted` and the checks are skipped [SOURCE: .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:30-46] [SOURCE: .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/post-commit:30-46]. The skip is not silent: the hook prints `NOTICE [gate:hook-trust]: this clone is not trusted, so the pre-commit checks were skipped.` plus the enable command [SOURCE: .skilled/scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:48-54]. The installer copies the hooks and selects the source root, and the README documents the machine-wide install and the trust requirement in the Git Hooks section [SOURCE: .skilled/scripts/install-git-hooks.sh:22-60] [SOURCE: README.md:189-197]. On the first-packet path the cost is near zero (creating a spec packet needs no commit); the cost lands at the first commit from a second clone or a moved checkout, where all gates -- including comment hygiene -- are skipped and only a stderr notice records why. The trust line is prose mid-section, not a numbered install step, so a user who honors only the numbered steps never sees it [SOURCE: README.md:164-177] [SOURCE: README.md:197].

That tree is fully tracked (6996 `z_archive` files) and the exact path was confirmed present in `o2-fresh-clone`, so the fresh-clone default path never misses it. The honest cost is structural fragility, not a current stumble: moving or deleting the archived spec tree (e.g., a specs cleanup) makes sync fail and blocked commits appear. The sync tool's own header acknowledges the authored source sits under a "mutable documentation tree" [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/compiled-route-sync.cjs:6-9], and it ships a `--verify` mode that simulates the move [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/compiled-route-sync.cjs:20-24]. Cost on the first packet: none. Cost immediately after: one mandatory, unexplained-to-a-newcomer choice (confused-by-choice), and a wrapper session started before installs links nothing.
